title: Catalogue has the right columns and types
expected: Columns as data-contracts §2; only the 10 D-03 types; no type over 500 rows

title: Catalogue build is repeatable
steps: Run make catalogue again; compare product_id lists
expected: Identical IDs in identical order

title: Unusable products are dropped and counted
expected: Dropped counts by reason (no image / no label / image under 200 px); none of those IDs in the catalogue

title: Reserved types stay out of the catalogue
steps: Look for Sarees, Watches and Sunglasses in catalogue.parquet and holdout.parquet
expected: None in the catalogue; all present in the holdout file

title: One index per model, aligned with the catalogue
expected: openclip and fashionclip folders each hold vectors.faiss, ids.npy (same length as the catalogue) and meta.json

title: Stored vectors are normalised
steps: Read every vector; compute its length
expected: Every length is 1 within 0.001

title: A catalogue image finds itself
steps: Search 200 sampled catalogue images against their own model's index
expected: At least 198 of 200 return themselves at rank 1, for each model

title: Out-of-date index is refused
precondition: Index built; catalogue rebuilt with a different seed
expected: Refuses to start: 'Index is out of date: run make index'

title: Every photo has a valid label
expected: No photo without a row, no row without a photo; every type and colour in eval/vocabulary.csv; not_fashion rows have no type or colour

title: Query photos carry no EXIF
expected: No EXIF block in any file

title: Split never changes once assigned
expected: Old photos keep their split; only the 5 new ones are assigned

title: Eval file has every row the plan needs
expected: Matches data-contracts §6; rows for random, openclip, fashionclip × dev, test × strict, type_only

title: Metric functions match hand-worked values
steps: Score the toy ranking in the test file
expected: Recall@10, Precision@10 and MRR equal the values worked by hand

title: Random baseline is repeatable
expected: Every number identical across the two files

title: Each metric has a confidence interval
expected: Every metric has a 95% bootstrap interval with lower ≤ value ≤ upper

title: Every read of the test split is logged
expected: A dated line appears in eval/results/test-reads.log

title: Benchmark records every stage and the CPU
expected: bench-<date>.json has p50 and p95 for decode, embed, search, server, end_to_end and names the CPU

title: Warm-up requests are excluded
steps: Run make bench; read the file
expected: warmup is 10 and percentiles cover the other 190 requests

title: Benchmark runs on CPU even with a GPU present
expected: Output says CPU was forced; no CUDA device used

title: Model choice is written with its reasons
precondition: Dev results and a bench file exist
expected: Chosen model and a sentence with the numbers in the results file and the API config

title: A small accuracy gap keeps the generic model
expected: openclip chosen

title: Latency over budget keeps the generic model
precondition: Fixture: FashionCLIP +12 points, p95 server 620 ms
expected: openclip chosen; reason names latency

title: Label counts are reported
expected: Counts by kind and type printed; warning for any type with under 4 test photos

title: Every web photo is credited under an allowed licence
precondition: Photos, labels.csv and sources.csv in eval/queries/
steps: Run make eval-check; then change one licence to by-nc and run it again
expected: Passes with every photo credited in ATTRIBUTION.md; fails naming the by-nc photo

title: Ten results, sorted
expected: 10 results; ranks 1–10; scores never increase down the list

title: Every result has its fields
steps: POST a photo; check each result; open each image_url
expected: All fields present; every image loads

title: A catalogue product finds itself
steps: POST a catalogue product's own image
expected: That product is rank 1

title: Timings are reported
expected: timings_ms has decode, embed, search and total

title: Phone offers camera and library
precondition: Phone browser on the home page
expected: System picker offers the camera and the photo library

title: Desktop: choose or drop a file
precondition: Desktop browser on the home page
steps: Choose a JPEG; then drop a PNG on the page
expected: Each starts a search

title: Upload is shrunk and has no EXIF
precondition: 12 MP phone photo with GPS EXIF
expected: Image ≤ 640 px on its long side; no EXIF

title: Crop sends only the chosen area
steps: Crop to one item; drag the box around the shoes; Search
expected: Only the cropped area is sent; results are mostly shoes

title: Crop works by keyboard
steps: Tab to the box; arrows to move; Shift+arrows to resize; Enter
expected: Box moves and resizes; search runs on the cropped area

title: A non-photo file is refused
expected: 'That file isn't a photo. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP.'; nothing sent

title: API down: photo kept, Retry works
steps: Search; start the API; tap Retry
expected: Offline message; Retry searches with the same photo and shows results

title: Slow API times out at 10 s
expected: Request cancelled at 10 s; offline message with Retry

title: An oversize file that can't be shrunk is refused
precondition: Image file over 10 MB that the browser can't decode
expected: 'That photo is too large. Try a screenshot of it instead.'; nothing sent

title: Loading state shows at once
expected: Loading state with the photo thumbnail within 100 ms

title: First visit shows example photos
steps: Open the home page; tap an example
expected: Three examples and the one-line advice; tapping one runs a search

title: Crop box starts at the full photo
expected: Box covers the full photo

title: Result cards show the essentials
expected: Image, name, type and colour on every card; the shopper's photo as a thumbnail above

title: Product page and Back
expected: Product page with larger image and details; Back shows the same results with no new /search request

title: Results work by keyboard
steps: Search with an example; Tab to a result; Enter
expected: Every step reachable; focus visible; alt text is the product name

title: Phone width 360 px
expected: No sideways scroll; at least 4 results visible without scrolling

title: Chips list the types in the top 50
expected: Chips match the distinct article types in types_in_top_50

title: A chip filters the results
expected: Ten results, all Shirts, ranked by score

title: Tapping a chip again clears it
expected: Unfiltered results return

title: More like this leaves the product out
expected: Ten other products; the product itself isn't listed

title: More like this is tagged in analytics
expected: search_submitted has source: similar

title: Not clothing: no close match
precondition: API running with the dev-tuned floor
steps: Search with a photo of a mug
expected: 'No close match in this catalogue' with Retake and Crop; no product grid

title: Garment not in the catalogue: no close match
steps: Search with a photo of a saree
expected: Same no-match panel

title: Show closest anyway
expected: Ten closest products with a note that they're weak matches

title: Blurry photo gets a banner
steps: Search with a blurred dev photo
expected: Results plus 'This photo looks blurry, so results may be off.' and Retake

title: Dark photo gets a banner
steps: Search with a dark dev photo
expected: Results plus 'This photo is quite dark, so results may be off.' and Retake

title: Good photo, no banner
steps: Search with a sharp, well-lit photo
expected: No banner

title: Few false alarms on sharp photos
steps: Run the quality check on every sharp dev photo
expected: At most 1 in 10 triggers a banner

title: The floor comes from dev photos
steps: Compare config, decisions.md and the dev-tuning output
expected: Same value in all three; tuned on dev only

title: Search and click events reach PostHog
steps: Search; open rank 3; check PostHog live events
expected: search_submitted, results_shown and result_clicked (rank 3) with the §7 properties

title: App works with PostHog blocked
precondition: Ad blocker on, or no key
expected: Works normally; no error shown

title: No-match event
expected: no_match_shown with top_score and floor

title: Layout assignment is stable
expected: Same layout every time

title: Every results and click event carries the layout
steps: Search and open a result in each layout
expected: layout_variant is A or B on results_shown and result_clicked

title: Flag timeout falls back to layout A
expected: Layout A shown; events carry layout_variant: fallback

title: Search writes no file
precondition: API running; snapshot of working, data and temp dirs
expected: No new files

title: Logs hold no image data
precondition: API running at debug log level
expected: No image bytes, file names or EXIF fields

title: Events hold no image data
steps: Search, crop and open a result; inspect every payload
expected: No image data, file name or EXIF field

title: Builds and runs with no paid key
steps: make setup, catalogue, index, api, web; search
expected: Everything works; analytics off

title: Camera search on iPhone Safari
expected: Camera opens; results show

title: Camera search on Android Chrome
expected: Camera opens; results show

title: Contrast meets WCAG 2.2 AA
precondition: Home, results, no-match and product pages
expected: No contrast violations

title: p95 inside the latency budget
steps: Read p95 server and end to end
expected: Server ≤ 500 ms; end to end ≤ 1,500 ms; else a decision is logged
